source(output(
		union_cd as string,

		ann_svs_hrs_la as integer,
		base_hrs_casual as string,

		base_hrs_part as string,
		unpaid_loa_vac_yr as string,
		max_vac_entlm_hrs as integer,
		ph_union_type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '/*Feb 28, 2011: ZK - one rec per union cd, using the latest effective date*/  select 		union_cd, 		descr,  		descrshort, 		certification_unit, 		sector,         effdt,          eff_status,          country,          address1,          address2,          address3,          address4,          city,          num1,          num2,          house_type,         addr_field1,          addr_field2,          addr_field3,          county,          [state],          postal,          geo_code,          in_city_limit,          contact_name,          country_code,          phone,          union_steward_name,          contract_begin_dt,          contract_end_dt,          vacation_plan,          sick_plan,          sdi_admin_pct,          disability_ins,          life_ins,          retmt_pickup_pct,          fica_pickup,          callback_min_hours,          callback_rate,          tuition_limit,          certified,          closed_shop,          std_hours,          work_day_hours,                                      ann_svs_hrs_f,          ann_svs_hrs_la,          base_hrs_casual,          base_hrs_full,          base_hrs_part,          unpaid_loa_vac_yr,          max_vac_entlm_hrs,          ph_union_type    from (   SELECT union_cd, 	   descr,  	   descrshort,         CASE A.union_cd WHEN \'100\' THEN \'HEU Facilities\' WHEN \'101\' THEN \'IUOE Facilities\' WHEN \'102\' THEN \'BCGEU Facilities\' WHEN \'200\' THEN \'BCNU Or UPN\'                 WHEN \'300\' THEN \'BCGEU Comm\' WHEN \'400\' THEN \'HSA Or PEA Paramed\' WHEN \'401\' THEN \'BCGEU Paramed\' WHEN \'402\' THEN \'HSA Or PEA Paramed\'                    WHEN \'500\' THEN \'BCGEU Comm\' WHEN \'501\' THEN \'BCNU Or UPN\' WHEN \'502\' THEN \'BCNU Or UPN\' WHEN \'503\' THEN \'HSA Or PEA Paramed\' WHEN                    \'900\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'901\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'902\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'903\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'904\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\'                    WHEN \'905\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'910\' THEN \'Physician\' WHEN \'920\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'921\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'922\' THEN \'Physician\'                    WHEN \'940\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'941\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'942\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'943\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'944\' THEN                    \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'945\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'946\' THEN \'Physician\' WHEN \'947\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'948\' THEN \'Mgmt\'                    WHEN \'960\' THEN \'Mgmt\' WHEN \'961\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'963\' THEN \'Physician\' WHEN \'964\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'965\' THEN                    \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'966\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'967\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'969\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'980\'                    THEN \'Physician\' WHEN \'981\' THEN \'Other Non Contract\' WHEN \'999\' THEN \'Non Employee\' WHEN \'NON\' THEN \'Non Employee\' WHEN \'PSC\' THEN \'BCGEU Comm\'                    ELSE \'Uncategorized\'          END AS certification_unit,          CASE WHEN A.union_cd LIKE \'5%\' THEN \'Public\' ELSE \'Health\' END AS sector,          effdt,          eff_status,          country,          address1,          address2,          address3,          address4,          city,          num1,          num2,          house_type,         addr_field1,          addr_field2,          addr_field3,          county,          [state],          postal,          geo_code,          in_city_limit,          contact_name,          country_code,          phone,          union_steward_name,          contract_begin_dt,          contract_end_dt,          vacation_plan,          sick_plan,          sdi_admin_pct,          disability_ins,          life_ins,          retmt_pickup_pct,          fica_pickup,          callback_min_hours,          callback_rate,          tuition_limit,          certified,          closed_shop,          std_hours,          work_day_hours,                                      ann_svs_hrs_f,          ann_svs_hrs_la,          base_hrs_casual,          base_hrs_full,          base_hrs_part,          unpaid_loa_vac_yr,          max_vac_entlm_hrs,          ph_union_type,         r=row_number() over (partition by union_cd order by effdt desc, eff_status asc)  FROM        [ps_hcm].[ps_union_tbl] AS A) r_union where r=1',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		union_key as short,

		description as string,

	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
